'''Marc Renaud''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]] in March 2000 with Tatooine system with Court and Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ quebec-championship], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He received a Day 2 automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]] from the [[2008 Quebec Provincial Championship]] of 24 May 2008.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref> He was tournament director of the [[2008 Canadian Nationals]] on Saturday 2 August 2008 at the Le Chevalier store in Repentigny, Quebec: six games of Swiss with a final confrontation, decklists mandatory.<ref name="sf-21984-316639">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316639#p316639 Canadian Nationals - info in first post], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008).</ref>
